title: Focused test-thread reporting: homedir failure can fail a passed run, CARGO_HOME handling differs from the launcher's, direct wrapper form reports unknown
outcome: Reading a focused run's test-thread setting can never decide the run, Cargo's configuration directories are found by one shared helper with the same CARGO_HOME rules as the launcher's, a directly executed scripts/test-rust.sh reports its count or the doc is narrowed, and a test covers the direct cargo wiring at the launcher's call site.
acceptance: A throw while reading the setting records unknown and leaves the stage's verdict unchanged, with a test
cargoConfigTexts and cargoConfigSelectsRustc share one directory listing, with Windows-spelling, empty and relative CARGO_HOME covered
focused -- scripts/test-rust.sh reports the wrapper's count, or docs/test.md no longer says it does
An end-to-end launcher test covers a direct cargo test's args, environment and configuration wiring
